notes.title: Breaking bread on the first day of the week
notes.intro: Believers in Troas gather on the first day of the week to break bread.

views.label: Evidence for Sunday worship
views.summary: Most churches see here early Christian gathering on Sunday, the day of resurrection.

views.label: The pattern for weekly Communion
views.summary: Churches of Christ take this as the New Testament pattern for celebrating the Lord’s Supper every Sunday.
views.source: Common teaching in Churches of Christ

views.label: A special meeting, not a change of Sabbath
views.summary: Seventh-day Adventists read it as a one-off evening gathering (by Jewish reckoning, Saturday night) that does not change the Sabbath.
views.source: Seventh-day Adventists Believe (2018), on the Sabbath
